messages:
marta: Heads-up — we need quota increases in GCP (us-central1 + us-west1) to provision a Redwood Dedicated GPU pool for next-week onboarding. Filing with GCP now, cc @raj @kai. Short list in replies.

cloud-ops-bot: Created support case CASE-2026-00014234 -> GCP internal case 987654321. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321

raj: Can you paste the exact quotas/targets we requested? Need numbers for finance and infra planning.

marta: Sure — copying the requested quotas:
```
project: redwood-dedicated-prod
region: us-central1, us-west1
requested_by: infra-oncall
quota_changes:
  - A100_40GB_GPUS (regional): current 48 -> requested 96
  - GPUs (any other family): keep default
  - Static External IPs (regional): 50 -> 200
  - Forwarding Rules: 100 -> 300
  - In-use VMs per region: 500 -> 1200
  - Internal Load Balancer (ILB) forwarding rules: 50 -> 200
justification: onboarding 3 customers with Dedicated pools, predictable throughput, need headroom for autoscaling and failovers
start_date: 2026-03-22
```

sophie: Also request bump for "Network routes per project" and "VPC-peering routes"? We hit those in staging last quarter. Small note: include cost cap + TTL on unused reserved IPs to avoid surprises.

kai: I looped in our GCP SE. They asked for per-customer qps and expected sustained GPU-hours. I uploaded a short justification doc to the ticket and added a traffic profile.

GCP Support: Update on case 987654321 — assigned to CloudEng-Team. Initial review complete; we require supplementation on QPS & MCS (multi-cluster) plan. Please attach: traffic_profile.csv and expected sustained GPU hours per week. ETA for review: 48 hours. Reference escalation ID: ESC-2B-3344.

marta: Uploaded traffic_profile.csv and the spreadsheet with per-customer GPU hour projections. Also added our burst/baseline plan and a note about fallback to quantized variants.

cloud-ops-bot: Case 987654321 status -> Pending Quota Allocation. Allocation request ID: ALLOC-3345.

raj: Any ETA on when allocations will actually reflect in the quota API? Need to schedule provisioning windows.

GCP Support: Allocation scheduled for 2026-03-20 14:00 PDT (subject to final approval). After allocation, quotas should show in the Quotas page and via the API within ~30 minutes. If you need an earlier slot, reply with URGENT and your escalation contact, or use your SE to request a manual expedite (ref ESC-2B-3344).

sophie: Quick cost check for planning — spinning up 96 A100_40GB workers (on-demand) for a baseline fleet would be ~240k–320k USD/month ballpark. We plan to use a mix of committed usage + preemptible and reuse Dedicated reservations to lower that. Finance wants a worst-case and a mitigated estimate.

kai: Noted — I'll share the cost model and committed usage options in the ticket. Also flagging we need to increase our egress NAT gateway quota if we start many outbound connections from all these instances.

marta: Thanks. Marking provisioning window tentative: 2026-03-21 evening -> start smoke tests; full scale 2026-03-22 morning assuming quotas are allocated.

GCP Support: Follow-up: Allocation ALLOC-3345 completed for most items. Static IPs and A100 GPU regional quota increases are pending final manual allocation. We're expediting; we will post another update within 6 hours.

cloud-ops-bot: Case 987654321 updated: note added by GCP Support — manual review in progress.

raj: OK — I'll delay cluster bootstrap until we see the final allocations. @marta please paste the exact API call we should use to validate quotas once allocated.

marta: Use gcloud:
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=redwood-dedicated-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="A100_GPUS")'
# or for quotas across project:
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-dedicated-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric|test("A100|GPUS|STATIC_ADDRESSES"))'
```

kai: I'll pick this up in the oncall handover and follow up with GCP SE if we don't get the final allocation in 8 hours. Leaving a note for the provisioning runbook: if allocated partially, prioritize A100 quota first, then static IPs, then forwarding rules.

GCP Support: Final update: Manual allocation for A100 GPUs and Static IPs completed at 2026-03-20T21:05:00Z. Quotas should be visible in console and API now. If anything missing, reopen case 987654321 or reference escalation ESC-2B-3344 for urgent assistance.

marta: Verified via API — A100 quota now 96 in us-central1. Static IPs increased. Starting canary bootstrap. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

kai: Adding a short postmortem note in #incidents if we see any provisioning blips. Moving this thread to archive.
